title: hotfix: tighten SLO enforcer backoff and stabilize regional failover under load
author: Ava Patel
description: Context: production incident INT-3381 exposed two reliability gaps in the SLO enforcer and regional failover logic under sustained tail-latency spikes: (1) the enforcer's exponential backoff floor allowed aggressive load-shedding loops on transient regional errors, and (2) the regional failover decision path raced with inflight capacity signals causing repeated failover thrash. This hotfix tightens the backoff policy, adds coordinated jitter, and serializes the failover decision path to avoid thrashing. Checklist: - Reproduce failure mode with synthetic canary; - Implement backoff tightening + jitter; - Serialize regional failover decision; - Add new unit/integration tests that simulate transient regional errors; - Update runbook and alert thresholds. Motivation: reduce user-facing errors and avoid large-scale cascading failovers during noisy upstreams. Rollout plan: small canary in us-west-2 for 30m, monitor slo_enforcer.errors and regional_failover.flaps metrics, then progressive rollout to remaining regions. Related: ENG-4821 for long-term enforcer refactor; SRE-1198 for alert tuning.
commits: 7 commits: 1) tighten backoff defaults and add jitter; 2) guard failover path with in-progress flag; 3) add unit tests for backoff edge cases; 4) add integration test to simulate region flapping; 5) metrics + tracing for decision path; 6) update runbook and docs; 7) bump canary config and rollout script.
review_comments: Diego Martinez (reviewer): The backoff floor change looks sensible, but curious if we should gate the new defaults behind a feature flag to allow rolling back quicker. Author reply: opted to roll out via canary + config change in k8s rather than feature flag to minimize runtime branching; can revert config if needed.

Lina Zhao (reviewer): There's a subtle race in regional_failover.go where multiple goroutines can attempt to flip the failover state; suggested using a CAS + metric increment. Author reply: implemented an in-progress mutex + metrics; added test that asserts only one transition per window.
Marcus Nguyen (approver): Verified fix in staging with simulated flaps; integration test reproduced previous thrash and now remains stable. Approval: LGTM after small test name nitfix.
QA (comment): Integration test intermittently failed on first CI run (timeout). Author reply: increased test timeout and made the synthetic workload deterministic; re-ran and CI passed.
release_notes: Hotfix: tighten SLO enforcer backoff (lower default floor, added jitter) and serialize regional failover decision path to prevent thrashing during transient regional errors. Includes tests and runbook updates. Mitigates INT-3381. Rollout: canary -> regional -> global.
notes: Deployed as a hotfix with monitored canary. No customer-facing config changes required; operator can adjust slo-config via k8s to tune aggressiveness. Follow-up: ENG-4821 for enforcer refactor and long-term backoff tunables.
